name: wait_for_summon_end

stack.evidence: func_001DB990 takes no Script context and returns wait status 4 while summon-state bits 0x2000 or 0x4000 are set in D_002C1EA8, otherwise completion status 2

notes: The summon subsystem sets bit 0x2000 when a summon begins and clears it when the summon transition task finishes; it uses bit 0x4000 for the active summoned-character phase and clears that bit during dismissal cleanup. Both JP calls occur in pp10.ard and pc12.ard event-transition sequences, immediately after command 572 and immediately before wait_for_all_interface_tasks.
